reference_sql:
SELECT o.customer_id
FROM orders o
WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND o.channel = 'web'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts = (
    SELECT MIN(o2.order_ts)
    FROM orders o2
    WHERE o2.customer_id = o.customer_id
  )
alternatives:
WITH first_orders AS (
  -- one row per registered customer
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_ts) AS first_ts
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT o.customer_id
FROM orders o
JOIN first_orders f ON f.customer_id = o.customer_id AND f.first_ts = o.order_ts
WHERE o.channel = 'web'
  AND f.first_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
  AND f.first_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'

solver.query:
WITH first_o AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_ts) AS first_ts FROM orders WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT DISTINCT f.customer_id FROM first_o f JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = f.customer_id AND o.order_ts = f.first_ts WHERE o.channel = 'web' AND f.first_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00' AND f.first_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
